Priya (PM): Quick: need to lock GA guardrails today. Hosted SLA, Dedicated SLO, fallback billing backstop.
Omar (SRE): Staging: hosted p95 ~185ms; dedicated ~105ms.
Bea - Support: Customers asking for <=120ms p95. If we promise that, support wants explicit escalation path + 24/7 for those contracts.
Luca (Infra): We can offer: Hosted public SLA = 200ms p95; Dedicated SLO = 110ms p95 with contract uplift (~1.8x). Runtime must tag requests with "slo_tier" and "route_id".
Priya (PM): Decision draft: public = 200ms p95; enterprise reserved = 110ms p95 opt-in; fallback to higher-precision variant when route_p95 > baseline*1.15 for 3m. Billing: notify+opt-out, auto-credit only on sustained misses >2h.
Omar (SRE): Add hard gate: quantized variants must pass critical prompt set <=2% quality delta. Also add per-customer p95 reporting.
Bea - Support: I'll draft one-pager + support runbook templates and sample credit wording.
Luca (Infra): I'll open telemetry tickets: per-route p50/p95/p99, fallback_rate, cost_delta. Retention: 90d raw, 1y aggregated.
policy-bot: policy-bot: Reminder: any SLA credit wording must be approved by Legal before public release.
Priya (PM): Owners: Bea -> docs & runbook; Luca -> runtime tags & telemetry; Omar -> eval gate & escalation thresholds. I'll update acceptance matrix and file PR by 09:00.
